title: Tenant scoping verified by reclassifying the rewritten payload
description: Hub mode rewrites envelope/MCP/UMICP resource fields into user_<id>:<name> (auth::scope_envelope, next to classify_envelope), then reclassifies the rewritten payload and refuses the command unless every access lies in the tenant namespace. One check fails closed for keyspace-wide/admin accesses, non-string names and any field the rewrite missed; scripts are refused explicitly. An exhaustive unit test walks every envelope command with every resource field filled in. HTTP routes use an allow-list (router::is_tenant_route) so new routes answer 403 in Hub mode until reviewed.
whenToUse: Any rewrite of untrusted input that must stay in lockstep with an existing classifier or policy table.
whenNotToUse: When the classifier is not authoritative about what the handler touches; fix the classifier first.
